about_the_game:
The Allied betrayal of Czechoslovakia at Munich and the later German annexation of that country is a key moment in the historical march towards World War II in Europe. But imagine a world where the White Lion of Prague was prepared to face German aggression - bravery in the face of oppression. Explore that scenario in Peace for Our Time, a new Focus Pack for Hearts of Iron IV.

Created in collaboration with veteran modders Logan ‘Spicy Alfredo’ Calkins, Abbus Fung and Marijn ‘marijn211’ Vroegh, this Focus Pack offers new options for Czechoslovakia in a desperate fight for survival against overwhelming odds, posing a unique challenge to all Hearts of Iron IV players.

Hearts of Iron IV: Peace for Our Time features include:

  • Democratic National Focus Path: Surrounded by non-democratic nations, safeguard Czechoslovakia’s freedom by forging your own faction, leading a government in exile or pursuing independence as Slovakia.

  • Communist National Focus Path: Spark a socialist revolution to replace the failed middle path, joining the Comintern or uniting the region under your own federation; whether through radical struggle or moderate reform. 

  • Monarchist and Fascist National Focus Paths: Rally nationalist forces to establish a new kingdom of Bohemia or embrace military dictatorship, expand your influence through allies or subjects, and decide whether to entrench authoritarianism or return to democracy once the crisis has passed.

  • Manage your arms industry, become an industrial powerhouse, and shape conflicts across the globe by exporting weapons abroad.

  • New Art, including 3D depictions of the historical Prague Castle and Bojnice Castle, new equipment graphics, and new focus icons and character portraits.

  • Engage with the Divided Nation mechanic to solve the challenges of governing a divided democracy.

  • Army Confidence Mechanic forces you to ensure you have the support of the military.

  • New Art, including 3D depictions of the historical Prague Castle and Bojnice Castle, new equipment graphics, and new focus icons and character portraits.,
